title: Batch replication report
description: One run of `wipctl sync --all --json`: this plan and every slot in the declared set, visited in four passes. This is a different shape from sync.schema.json, which stays exactly as it was. One is an object about one plan and the other is a run over many, so giving both to one schema would make every field of the smaller one optional and check neither.

schema_version.description: This shape's own version marker. The batch report is the one output whose element set grows with the closure, so a consumer reading it across releases needs a fact to branch on that is not a field's presence.

plans.description: One object per slot, in the order the run visited them: this plan first, then each plan in the order it was first declared. Deduplicated by uid, so a plan two rows reach appears once.

exit.description: The aggregate exit code the process returned, by a stated precedence: 1 when any slot failed a check or a transport operation, 3 when no slot failed and at least one could not take its lock, and 0 when every slot succeeded. A failure outranks a lock timeout, because a lock timeout is a retry and a failed check is a decision. The precedence is held by the conditionals below rather than stated only here, because a report whose code disagrees with its own outcomes is the defect this shape exists to make visible.

project_id.description: The slug naming this plan's slot on this machine.

uid.description: The plan's global identity, which is what the run deduplicated on.

outcome.description: What happened to this slot. Each slot is independent in the reconcile and publish passes: a failure stops that slot and nothing else, and the run continues so the summary names every slot. Every value is one a requirement defines, because a value the specification never explains is one a consumer reads as it pleases, and the exit conditionals below would then derive a code from a state nothing describes.

fetched.description: Commits fetched from this slot's remote plan trunk, as the single-plan report counts them.

reconciled.description: Disjoint changes combined semantically in this slot, as the single-plan report counts them.

pushed.description: Whether this slot's fast-forward push happened. A slot that failed verification is not pushed.

diagnostic.description: Why this slot failed or could not be entered. Present when the outcome is failed or locked, and absent otherwise.
